groups.group_name_vi: Chụp Hút Khói Bếp Công Nghiệp (Công Nghệ Capture Jet)

models.title: KVE - Capture Jet Commercial Kitchen Exhaust Hood (ETL)
models.description_en: The KVE Capture Jet Exhaust Hood is designed for projects that require a ventilation system balancing performance, energy efficiency, and smooth execution from design through turnover. Capture Jet with Side-Jet technology introduces capture air through a dedicated discharge panel to strengthen capture at the hood face and improve containment, allowing required exhaust airflow to be reduced (30-40% lower) while maintaining performance.

specs.Airflow reduction: Up to 30-40% lower exhaust airflow vs traditional hoods
specs.Filtration: Halton KSA multi-cyclone filters, up to 95% removal at 8 microns (ASTM F2519)
specs.Commissioning: Integrated T.A.B. ports for testing and balancing

models.seo_title: Commercial Kitchen Hood, Capture Jet KVE - ETL Listed - Halton

models.title: KVC - Capture Jet Exhaust Hood with Supply Air (ETL)
models.description_en: ETL Listed - The KVC hood uses the advanced Halton Capture Jet with Side-Jet technology to improve the capture and containment of the airflows generated by the cooking equipment. Overall exhaust airflow rates can be reduced up to 30% from those of traditional kitchen hoods. Features an integral front-discharge low-velocity supply air plenum, high-efficiency KSA grease filtration and optional Halton HCL Culinary Lights.

specs.Technology: Capture Jet with Side-Jet technology + integral supply air plenum
specs.Filtration: Halton KSA multi-cyclone (UL/NSF), up to 95% at 8 microns (ASTM F2519)

models.seo_title: Capture Jet KVC Exhaust Hood With Supply Air, ETL Listed - Halton

models.title: KVL - Capture Jet Low Profile Exhaust Hood with Plate Shelf (ETL)
models.description_en: The KVL low profile Capture Jet exhaust hood is a highly efficient kitchen ventilation hood that removes contaminated air and excess heat emitted by cooking equipment, helping to provide a comfortable and clean environment. It features Capture Jet Side-Jet technology to reduce exhaust airflow rates while improving capture efficiency and reducing energy consumption, with high-efficiency KSA grease filtration.

specs.Capture Jet airflow ratio: Not exceeding 10% of calculated exhaust airflow
specs.Filtration: Halton KSA multi-cyclone, 92% at 8 microns (ASTM F2519)
specs.Options: LED lighting/dimming, fire protection, backsplash, ceiling closure panels

models.seo_title: Capture Jet KVL Exhaust Hood, Low Profile with Plate Shelf - Halton

models.title: KVO - Capture Jet Oval Island Exhaust Hood (ETL)
models.description_en: The KVO Capture Jet oval island exhaust hood with perimeter jets is a highly efficient kitchen ventilation hood that removes contaminated air and excess heat emitted by cooking equipment, helping to provide a comfortable and clean environment. Designed as an island hood with perimeter jets and available in hundreds of custom powder coat finishes.

specs.Design: Oval island exhaust hood with perimeter jets
specs.Filtration: Halton KSA multi-cyclone (UL/NSF), up to 95% at 8 microns (ASTM F2519)
specs.Lighting: Halton HCL Culinary Lights / LED / LED Dimmable
specs.Customization: Hundreds of custom powder coat finishes

models.seo_title: Capture Jet KVO oval island exhaust hood - ETL Listed - Halton

models.title: KVE-CM - Capture Jet Continuous Mist Exhaust Hood (for solid fuel cooking)
models.description_en: ETL Listed to UL Standard UL 710 - The KVE-CM hood provides solutions for a variety of commercial food service ventilation applications over solid fuel cooking processes. Based on Halton's patented Capture Jet solution and advanced mechanical KSA filter technology with a continuous mist (water spray) feature initiated with the exhaust fan for grease and spark control.

specs.Certification: ETL Listed to UL Standard UL 710
specs.Technology: Patented Capture Jet solution + continuous mist
specs.Filtration: KSA multi-cyclone, up to 95% removal of particles >= 8 microns (ASTM F2519)
specs.Mist system: Continuous spray initiated with exhaust fan

models.seo_title: Capture Jet KVE-CM Continuous Mist Exhaust Hood - Halton

models.title: EO - Exhaust Only Commercial Kitchen Hood (light duty)
models.description_en: The EO hood is an extraction hood for exhaust of contaminated air released by cooking equipment with low heat loads. The hood is UL listed at 150 cfm per linear foot for light duty applications. Welded liquid-tight stainless steel construction with UL classified baffle filters and a perimeter drain channel.

specs.Application: Light duty cooking equipment with low heat loads
specs.Material: 18 gauge stainless steel, brushed satin finish
specs.Filtration: UL classified aluminum or stainless baffle filters
specs.Included: Outer casing, inner liner, exhaust duct, grease filters, perimeter drain channel, collection cup

models.seo_title: Commercial Kitchen Exhaust Hood, EO is UL listed - Halton

models.title: VCS - Ventilated Ceiling System (ETL)
models.description_en: The Halton Ventilated Ceiling System (VCS) is ETL Listed and a fully integrated, architecturally clean solution for light- to medium-duty commercial cooking environments. A ceiling-integrated ventilation approach that combines exhaust, supply air, and lighting into a modular ceiling grid to support open sightlines and a clean architectural look. Individually custom sized and designed for each kitchen ventilation project.

groups.group_name_vi: Hệ Thống Xử Lý Khí Thải / Khử Mùi Khói (PolluStop)

models.title: PST-A - Modular Pollution Control Unit (UL)
models.description_en: Modular Pollution Control Unit for Commercial Kitchen Ventilation - a UL Listed system designed to control airborne pollutants at discharge points, with capacity range from 3,000 to 24,000 CFM (up to 40,000 CFM available). Developed to complement the Capture Jet kitchen exhaust hoods or Ventilated Ceiling Systems, with a load-dependent design and application-specific filtration options.

specs.Capacity range: 3,000-24,000 CFM standard; up to 40,000 CFM available
specs.Filtration options: ELF (Extended Life Filter), Electrostatic Precipitator (ESP), Absolute Filter (MERV 16)
specs.ESP technology: Single/Double Pass modules with wash system and mist eliminators
specs.Odor control: Scentry liquid spray system, Carbon Panel Module, UV-C Carbon Module
specs.Construction: Double-wall heavy gauge shell with acoustic insulation
specs.Controls: Automatic exhaust fan regulation; BMS integration; remote monitoring

groups.group_name_vi: Điều Khiển Thông Gió Theo Nhu Cầu & Tiết Kiệm Năng Lượng (DCKV)

models.title: M.A.R.V.E.L. - Demand Controlled Kitchen Ventilation (ETL)
models.description_en: M.A.R.V.E.L. is Halton's advanced demand-controlled kitchen ventilation (DCKV) system that continuously adjusts exhaust and supply airflow based on real-time cooking activity. Designed for commercial kitchens with variable cooking loads to help reduce energy consumption while maintaining reliable capture and containment.

specs.Core function: Real-time airflow modulation based on cooking activity
specs.Energy savings: Up to 30-50% reduction in ventilation-related energy
